findings.problem: The phrase uses englisch, not among the 1,000 most common words.

back.example: Hello, do you speak English? I don't speak German.

note: The example reuses the unit's own phrase "Ich spreche kein Deutsch", which works as reinforcement; the colloquial "Können Sie Englisch?" also exists, but "Sprechen Sie Englisch?" is the standard answer.
